pairs.description: Ginger possesses antiplatelet properties and may potentiate bleeding tendencies in patients undergoing anticoagulation with warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of thromboxane synthetase and platelet cyclooxygenase by gingerol and shogaol constituents.

pairs.description: Concomitant administration of ginger and nifedipine produces synergistic inhibition of platelet aggregation in hypertensive volunteers.
pairs.mechanism: Complementary antiplatelet action through dual inhibition of calcium influx and platelet activation pathways.

pairs.description: Ginger extracts enhance glucose uptake in peripheral tissues, presenting a theoretical risk of additive hypoglycemia when combined with metformin.
pairs.mechanism: Stimulation of GLUT4 glucose transporter translocation to the cell membrane by gingerols.
